name: Quote over a photo
what: Your photo or video pulls back from a close-up and settles, then a big opening quote mark rises in, a closing mark slides in from the lower right, and the quote types itself in letter by letter between them.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f12 the scene holds zoomed in on its left; f12-f40 it pulls back (fast at f24, slow end); f45-f70 it pans right into its final framing; f113-f140 the opening quote mark rises in from below (its two halves 2 f apart); f126-f148 the closing mark slides in from the lower right (decelerating); f142-f208 the quote types in letter by letter (slow start, quick in the middle, slow end); then the scene floats a few pixels to f385

tracks.name: scene pull-back
tracks.what: the scene zooms out from about 1.4x to its final framing

tracks.name: scene pan
tracks.what: the scene pans right into its final framing

tracks.name: opening mark
tracks.what: two halves rise in from below, sliding right (2 f apart)

tracks.name: closing mark
tracks.what: slides in from the lower right

tracks.name: quote typing
tracks.what: letters fade in one after another (49 letters in the reference)
tracks.easing: slow start, quick middle, slow end

tracks.name: float
tracks.what: the scene drifts a few pixels
